name: iris-mcp-launcher
description: Registers the IRIS MCP Server Suite with VS Code, resolving credentials from the InterSystems Server Manager extension at spawn time. Copilot-family agents only — see README for the client-coverage boundary.

irisMcpLauncher.servers.description: InterSystems Server Manager server names to expose as IRIS MCP servers. Empty = all servers currently configured in Server Manager.

irisMcpLauncher.packages.description: Which @iris-mcp suite packages to register as MCP servers. (The former 'all' meta-package key was removed — @iris-mcp/all ships no dist/bin and could never be started; select the individual packages you need instead.)

irisMcpLauncher.namespace.description: Default IRIS namespace (IRIS_NAMESPACE) for every spawned MCP server. Matches the suite's own loadConfig() default.

irisMcpLauncher.combineProfiles.description: When true, register ONE MCP server definition per package covering ALL selected Server Manager servers (via the suite's IRIS_PROFILES multi-profile env var, addressable with the 'server' tool parameter). When false (default), register one definition per (package, server) pair, each single-profile.

irisMcpLauncher.developmentRepoPath.description: DEVELOPMENT ONLY. Absolute path to a local monorepo checkout of the IRIS MCP suite. Empty (default) spawns the published packages via 'npx -y @iris-mcp/<pkg>'. Non-empty spawns 'node <path>/packages/<dir>/dist/index.js' instead, for testing local changes before publishing. This executes an arbitrary local file path, so it is machine-scoped: it can only be set in your own User/Machine settings, never by a workspace's .vscode/settings.json. Only set it to a checkout you trust. A relative path is rejected — it must be absolute. A missing or unbuilt package registers no definition for that package and produces one warning; other selected packages still register.

irisMcpLauncher.governance.description: Passed through UNCHANGED as IRIS_GOVERNANCE to every spawned server. Empty = unset (today's default governance behavior).

irisMcpLauncher.governancePreset.description: Passed through UNCHANGED as IRIS_GOVERNANCE_PRESET. Empty = unset.

irisMcpLauncher.governanceFile.description: Passed through UNCHANGED as IRIS_GOVERNANCE_FILE to every spawned server (path to the shared governance policy file). ALSO the file the 'IRIS MCP Launcher: Open Governance Editor' view edits. Empty = unset (no governance file; the editor shows an empty state). Explicit path only, never discovered; prefer an absolute path. Servers read the file once at startup — restart a server to apply edits.

irisMcpLauncher.auditLog.description: Passed through UNCHANGED as IRIS_AUDIT_LOG (audit log file path). Empty = unset (auditing disabled).

irisMcpLauncher.auditLogMaxMb.description: Passed through UNCHANGED as IRIS_AUDIT_LOG_MAX_MB. Empty = unset (suite default applies).

irisMcpLauncher.auditLogParams.description: Passed through UNCHANGED as IRIS_AUDIT_LOG_PARAMS ('true'/'false'). Empty = unset.

irisMcpLauncher.toolsPreset.description: Passed through UNCHANGED as IRIS_TOOLS_PRESET ('full'/'core'/'developer'). Empty = unset (suite default 'full' applies).

irisMcpLauncher.toolsDisable.description: Passed through UNCHANGED as IRIS_TOOLS_DISABLE (comma-separated tool names, trailing-* wildcard supported). Empty = unset.

irisMcpLauncher.toolsEnable.description: Passed through UNCHANGED as IRIS_TOOLS_ENABLE (comma-separated tool names). Empty = unset.
